title: docs(spec): name the producer of ConnectorConnectionState.redirectUri

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9wL8eUVeLSJG2twNqGtFc8)_

Fixes #29715

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`ConnectorConnectionState.redirectUri` 的 TSDoc 末句，原来说「先声明、服务还没答，任何回答都不带它」，现在改成点名生产者：`@objectstack/service-automation` 的 `AutomationServicePlugin.getConnectorConnection` 在能推导出地址时设上它，否则不带。
- 为什么改：连接读取已经会返回 `redirectUri`（服务端那半已合并），但 spec 文档还说「没有回答带它」。这段注释随 `dist` 发布，照着它写客户端的人或 AI 会为一个其实总会返回的键写兜底逻辑。
- 风险与回滚：只改注释文字和新增一条 changeset，没有任何类型、schema 或取值变化；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts`（`redirectUri` 上方注释的最后一句）、`.changeset/29715-connector-redirect-uri-producer.md`（同版本 changelog 的更正段）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/contracts/connector-connection-redirect-uri.pin.test.ts`，应见全部用例通过；`git grep "until the automation service sets" packages/spec` 应无命中。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Before** (`origin/main` `3eeb81d1`), `packages/spec/src/contracts/automation-service.ts` L1196–L1198, the end of the `ConnectorConnectionState.redirectUri` TSDoc:

> Read-only: no connection request takes it. Declared ahead of the service that answers it: until the automation service sets it, no answer carries it.

**After:**

> Read-only: no connection request takes it. Its producer is `@objectstack/service-automation`: `AutomationServicePlugin.getConnectorConnection` (`packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`) sets it whenever the derivation has a base, and it is absent otherwise.

Read against the producer on `origin/main`: `getConnectorConnection` (`plugin.ts` L4128–L4134) spreads `redirectUri` into the state only when `derivedConnectorOAuthRedirectUri()` returns a value, and that helper (L3861–L3866) answers `undefined` when neither the `connectorOAuthRedirectUri` option nor an `http(s)` `OS_AUTH_URL` / `OS_BASE_URL` base exists. The wording follows `approval-service.ts`, which names its producer the same way ("plugin-approvals' `rowFromRequest` serves it").

Other copies, searched with `git grep` over `packages/spec/**`: no other "declared ahead" or "no answer carries" prose about `redirectUri` (the other "declared ahead" hits are about unrelated keys). `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx` already says the status read answers `redirectUri`. No reference page is generated from this docblock: `ConnectorConnectionState` is a TypeScript interface, not a Zod schema, so neither `json-schema/` nor `content/docs/references/` carries it.

**Changeset route (the seat's call).** `.changeset/29574-connector-redirect-uri.md` is left untouched: the pending `.changeset/29463-connector-redirect-uri-read.md` in the same release already says the read now answers `redirectUri`. This PR's own changeset (`@objectstack/spec` patch) carries a "Supersedes, in the same release" paragraph saying the earlier "Declared ahead of the service" note no longer holds.

## Tests

No test changes. The existing pin `connector-connection-redirect-uri.pin.test.ts` reads this docblock and asserts the callback path, the derivation chain and both absence conditions; the edit leaves those sentences unchanged and the pin stays green.
